name: [🔧TIRES] Southern Mudding 🚜 OffRoading
desc:
Welcome to Southern Mudding! Explore a map purpose built for the off-road, using your selection of pickup trucks, semi trucks, trailers, classic cars, American muscle cars, and more! Whether you're here to off-road, play with friends, roleplay, or customize your vehicles, there's something for everyone!

🚨 October 23rd Update
- New Map Expansion! Includes a mountain town, trails, highway extension, and more!
- 2 New SUVs!
- New Attachment Customizations: Snorkel, Fishing Rod Holder, and more!

🚜 SM is built around depth, realism, and steady improvement. We focus on delivering vehicles that feel right, customization that matters, and updates that add real gameplay — not just surface changes. From heavy towing and deep mud runs to hauling, boating, and dialing in your perfect truck setup, everything is designed to work together. We plan our updates entirely around your suggestions and value the community.

👍⭐ Thumbs up if you like the game and want new updates!
❗Updates every Friday!
